projects.name: RI STIP FFY18-27 (Amendment 26) - Pavement Capital (lines)
projects.notes: RI Division of Statewide Planning STIP map for FFY2018-2027 as of Amendment 26 (2020): OUTDATED, the current STIP is FFY2022-2031 and no public GIS service for it was found. FY2018..FY2027 and TOTallocat are programmed dollars in MILLIONS by fiscal year; ProjectSta is free text, there is no clean phase field and no letting date. The map service has 15 layers by program (0-6 points, 7-13 lines, 14 polygon) with the same schema.

projects.name: RI Statewide Planning LRTP proposed projects (ProposedProjects_Line)
projects.notes: Small (a few dozen) set of proposed long-range plan projects from RI Statewide Planning; ProjStatus (e.g. Planning), FundStatus and STIPYr (e.g. 'FY 22 - 31') tie some to the current STIP. Cost is mostly blank. Supplementary only.

summary: Only an outdated STIP map service (FFY2018-2027, 2020 amendment) and a small LRTP proposed-projects layer were found; no current RIDOT planned-projects GIS service was verified. Parcel research pending.
